description: This PHP script handles the editing and display of custom views in the vtiger CRM system, including retrieving, displaying, and permission checking for custom view configurations, filters, and columns.

classes.name: CustomView
classes.description: Class managing custom view configurations, filters, and permissions in vtiger CRM.

methods.name: getStdFilterHTML
methods.description: Returns HTML options for standard filters based on module.
